properties.name: embeddingStoreId
properties.description: The id of the embedding store

properties.name: action
properties.description: The operation to perform: ADD, REMOVE, or SEARCH

properties.name: embeddingModel
properties.description: Embedding model for auto-computing embeddings from message body text. When set, ADD and SEARCH operations can accept plain text body instead of requiring a pre-computed embedding in the CamelLangChain4jEmbeddingsEmbedding header. The header always takes precedence when present.

properties.name: embeddingStore
properties.description: Direct embedding store instance for vector operations

properties.name: embeddingStoreFactory
properties.description: The embedding store factory to use for creating embedding stores if no embeddingstore is provided

properties.name: maxResults
properties.description: Maximum number of results to return for SEARCH operation

properties.name: minScore
properties.description: Minimum similarity score threshold for SEARCH operation (0.0 to 1.0)

properties.name: returnTextContent
properties.description: When true, SEARCH returns List with text content instead of List

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
